config.field.configFile: Configuration backup retention and write-lock waiting
config.approval.summary.unset: Setting will be removed: {key} {before} → the next layer's value ({layer})
config.approval.pending: Nothing was written; approval {id} is pending. What: {summary}
config.approval.resubmitCli: Decide it with /approvals in the terminal or deckent approvals. After an allow, run the same command again with --command-id {commandId} --expect {expect} to apply it.
config.approval.resubmitTerminal: Decide it with /approvals. After an allow, choose the same value and layer in /config again (line mode: repeat the command).
config.surface.slashReadOnly: /config is read only here: no write route is connected. Change settings with deckent config set/unset.
config.surface.title: Configuration · {project}
config.surface.service.current: The running service already uses this configuration.
config.surface.service.stale: Restart required: the running service started with the previous configuration. Restart it with `deckent runtime restart` (or /service-restart in the terminal).
config.surface.service.unknown: Whether the running service uses this value could not be determined (it reports no configuration fingerprint). Restart it with `deckent runtime restart` to be sure.
config.surface.service.stopped: No service is running; the value applies at the next service start.
config.surface.overridden: Saved value is overridden by a later layer (project or environment).
config.surface.slashUsage: /config [key] · view. /config set <key> <json> · /config unset <key> · change the project layer (policy authorization; an approval may be asked).
config.surface.help:
deckent config [--json] [--global] [--lang en|tr]

Inspect
  get [key] [--json]       compatible value output
  explain <key> [--json]   description, schema, source and binding
  validate                validate the full effective configuration

Change (policy authorization required; a policy may ask for an approval first — nothing is written until it is allowed)
  set <key> <json> [--global] [--expect <digest|absent>] [--scope <id>]
  unset <key> [--global] [--expect <digest|absent>] [--scope <id>]
  --command-id <id>       audit command identity
Use --expect absent to require a missing document. Explain uses the project view; --global is refused. Project is the default write layer. Secrets use deckent secret.
Use explain to see environment overrides and restart requirements.
config.surface.fieldRetired: Removed unused setting {key}; document schema 3 is read as schema 4.
error.CONFIG_SECRET_SECTION_REFUSED: Secrets must be changed with deckent secret. Configuration writes to the secrets section are refused.
error.CONFIG_LAYER_INVALID: Choose project or global as the configuration write layer.
error.CONFIG_DIGEST_INVALID: Expected document digest must be a 64-character SHA-256 hexadecimal digest.
error.CONFIG_ARRAY_INDEX_INVALID: Configuration array index must be canonical, within range, and owned by the array.
error.CONFIG_KEY_NOT_OBJECT: The configuration path traverses a scalar; set its parent document instead.
error.CONFIG_METADATA_MISSING: Configuration section metadata is incomplete; binding and apply information are required.
config.surface.monitorHelp: {index}                Config: read configuration, source, binding and apply mode
config.surface.shortcutInvalid: {key} does not take that value; nothing was written. /config {key} shows what it takes.

config.field.service.events: Bounded observation subscriptions, replay and source freshness; requires restart.
config.field.service.events.enabled: Enable read-only event subscriptions after service restart.
config.field.service.events.maxSubscribe: Maximum active subscriptions; must leave a connection available for commands.
Maximum subscriptions owned by one authenticated principal.
config.field.service.events.maxViews: Maximum principal, scope and policy bound replay views retained in memory.
config.field.service.events.subscriberMa: Maximum pending items per subscriber, including a reserved gap slot.
Pending JSON byte budget per subscriber; overflow requires a new snapshot.
config.field.service.events.viewReplayMa: Maximum replay changes retained per authorized view.
Maximum replay JSON bytes retained per authorized view.
config.field.service.events.resumeTtlMs: Retention time for inactive view bindings; detached views do not keep collectors running.
config.field.service.events.readPageSize: Maximum source rows read in one page.
config.field.service.events.maxSnapshotR: Maximum rows in one source capture; exceeding the bound is an explicit refusal.
config.field.service.events.maxSnapshotB: Maximum raw source and projected snapshot bytes per capture.
config.field.service.events.snapshotDead: Maximum time for a snapshot capture and authorization pass.
config.field.service.events.snapshotRetr: Maximum recaptures after an explicitly raced source capture.
config.field.service.events.heartbeatMs: Transport heartbeat interval; heartbeat is not evidence of worker liveness.
config.field.service.events.idleTimeoutM: Client idle and callback deadline for the subscription transport.
config.field.service.events.drainTimeout: Maximum wait for a slow socket or stdout consumer to drain.
config.field.service.events.closeGraceMs: Grace before disconnecting subscription sockets during service shutdown.
config.field.service.events.authorizatio: Maximum idle interval between fresh admission checks.
config.field.service.events.reconcileInt: Bounded source reconciliation interval when notifications are missed or coalesced.
config.field.service.events.maxConcurren: Maximum concurrent observation captures; execution slots are separate.
config.field.service.events.liveWorkerMa: Maximum worker metadata events sampled per safe sidecar; caps produce source loss.
Maximum bytes read from a safe worker event sidecar.
config.field.service.events.liveWorkerFl: Maximum interval for refreshing live worker metadata.
